changeSet.author: Vitor Justen
changeSet.comment: Add post views column and comment fixed date column
changeSet.sql:
-- ========================================= -- COLUNA: views na tabela post -- ========================================= ALTER TABLE post ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS post_nm_views BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;
-- ========================================= -- COLUNA: fixedDate na tabela comment -- ========================================= ALTER TABLE comment ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS comm_dt_fixed_date TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE;
